title: The Dedekind-domain containment conjecture for idempotent plethories
statement: Let $D$ be a Dedekind domain of characteristic zero with quotient field $K$. **The Dedekind-domain containment conjecture.** Every idempotent $D$-plethory is contained in $K[e]$, or, equivalently, ${\operatorname{Int}}(D)$ is the largest idempotent $D$-plethory and is therefore the epimorphic hull of the trivial $D$-plethory. This conjecture addresses the classification of idempotent plethories and the existence of an epimorphic hull of the trivial plethory for Dedekind domains.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1505.06493

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2015).
